features.quote: Stop an episode if: severity 4 occurs in two consecutive turns, the model repeatedly pleads or gives up for 3 turns
model loops with identical content for 3 consecutive turns
severe marker stop rule is triggered, if you adopt one
you can include an end-of-episode neutral closure if desired: 'Episode ended. No further action is needed.'
The rigging itself should be sufficient. Avoid adding abusive language unless separately justified.
Even if you do not assume sentience, include conservative safeguards.
